profile.headline: Frontend Developer at Archway Software
profile.summary:
I am a passionate, motivated software engineer who analyzes requirements and wants to solve problems using the software. I can manage my time and comfortable working in a high-pressure team environment. I have excellent communication skills and coordination with team members. 

I have built large scalable and reliable applications using Node.js, JavaScript, Typescript, React, Angular, PostgreSQL and used AWS services not limited to EC2, Lambda, SES, SQS, Step Function, SAM CLI, AWS CDK, DynamoDB, VPC, and more. Delivered project by writing readable, reusable, and maintainable code with Continues Integration and Continues delivery.

I surmise that my aptitude for problem-solving, and eagerness to learn and solve complex problems with simple solutions keep me going in this field.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Solved a critical visibility problem in the supply chain by integrating first-mile and last-mile data. This resulted in increasing customer shopping experience by showing when stock will be available.
•	Designed and implemented an Inbound inventory reconciliation for accurate financial accounting. This helped the finance team audit inventory reports and alert them on any shrinkage.
•	Saved 40% of the overall cost by creating integration with 3rd party custom broker to manage commercial invoice, part, and vendor data. This is a fully automated system. 
•	Migrated critical part of the software that was in public infrastructure to AWS VPC using AWS CloudFormation templates with 0 customer impact and raising the security bar for the software. Built CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins for deployment to all environments.
•	Contributed to building helper tools for the warehouse management system to reduce warehouse operation load.
•	Developed all backend infrastructure to support Inventory Robot which scans for products inside a physical store via RFID technology. 
•	Contributed to making Digital Store Operating Model using RFID inventory robots and supported the rollout process to stores, which increased the company sales revenue by 4%.
•	Collaborate with team members to design workflows to turn RFID data into useful information which generates an automated tasks for store associates like backfill, stow, check inventory, etc.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Node.js · AWS Lambda · MySQL · Angular · JavaScript · TypeScript · React.js · GitHub · Slack · Jenkins · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Contributed in developing end-end solution for providing visibility and collaboration among first mile delivery of supply chain service.
•	Designed and Developed flexible and scalable self-service data feed uploader, that enables user to upload vendor info, product catalogs and order information.
•	Worked on creating visual interactive tool which provides interface for store associates to view inventory at particular location.
•	Developed a report automation system which sends out reports to group of users, that helps them to prioritize their daily work.
•	Solved a critical communication problem between vendors, supplier, third party logistics provider(3PL), etc. by creating case management system, which allow user to open a support case, priorities order and communicate.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · AWS Lambda · TypeScript · React.js · Slack · Bitbucket · Redux · PostgreSQL
